The London Church Index

Made by Freddy Law

The London churches that spend the most each year, from their own filed accounts, plus 13 national denominations and church networks (such as Co-Mission) shown alongside them without a rank. Each church shows its denomination, when it was founded and where it meets.

Editor's note: Roman Catholic parishes are not ranked, because their dioceses file one set of accounts for all parishes. Why
